# Voi Home

> Luxury real estate consultancy offering curated homes, villas, and investment properties in Istanbul and Bodrum, Türkiye — with Turkish citizenship-by-investment guidance.

Voi Home helps buyers find, evaluate, and purchase premium residential and investment property across Türkiye (Istanbul, Bodrum), checking the details - title deeds, permits, developer track record - that most buyers never see. We provide end-to-end advisory, from shortlisting to closing, including Turkish citizenship eligibility through qualifying real estate investment (minimum $400,000 USD).
